tsid = '1bfb5858-50ad-5299-b60a-f9890b9316fb'

            if ts.startswith("2018-10-22"):
                hour = int(ts[11:13])
                if 8 <= hour <= 18:
                    rows.append((ts, float(row["value"])))
rows.sort()
vals = [v for _,v in rows]
mean = sum(vals)/len(vals)
v12 = [v for t,v in rows if t.endswith("12:00")]
print(rows)
print("mean:", mean, "count:", len(vals))
print("v12:", v12)
print("more?", v12[0] > mean if v12 else None)
